note: V1 trip-campaign copy packet. Plan-stage (pre-generation). Each mechanism resolves to a real on-disk artifact; visible_features describe what the V1 copy actually does. Pixel mechanisms bind at W5.

mechanisms_fired.visible_feature: all copy passed a single fail-closed copy gate (W2), 19 post units plus 10 outreach units, binary verdict, no partial pass
every post and message declares its format and channel before the copy (text-only, carousel, short video, DM, cold email)
facts mined by three fresh-context extractors and the build fact-checked by a separate adversarial verifier; the orchestrator does not crown its own copy
copy is BJ-face-independent (faces allowed, never the load-bearing reason), no lifted IP, no fabricated heritage
the post arc runs an authored story spine with an open-loop question planted on day one and paid off at the close
the campaign reveals itself through the work being done and the running object advancing, not abstract claims (posts 4, 7, 8)
each beat names its format and the format fits the beat (text read, carousel build, short-video room)
the arc meters one open-loop question (withhold) and pays a visible accrual at posts 5 and 9 (deposit)
no fabricated heritage; the only market reference is one honest light line in post 10; the proof is the opened room
no lifted marks or homage in the copy; recognition rides original method (object, place, voice), per HARD NO'S
the only credibility claim is a real opened room, honest-only, logged with a campaign trace; no fake proof
copy sells the outcome and hides the method; no grade, gesture, or build recipe leaked
names a specific buyer (artist/brand/founder with a moment), the trigger (a dated moment coming), and a dollar-anchored outcome (a moment worth 10k or more)
copy makes only allowed claims; no platform, registry, network, or AI-company claim, per HARD NO'S
the public copy shows the meal (the built campaign and the outcome), never the kitchen (the OS internals)
the first touches deposit real value (a free gap-map or teardown), not four empty withholds (post 3, outreach value-first)
the READ posts carry operator judgment and the value-first teardown is something only the real operator could produce (post 6)
each lane carries a kill threshold and a fair test before a kill; the access leg uses an honest-stop, never a faked receipt
